problem.title: Who actually pays for all the extras?
problem.text: Birth preparation, acupuncture for nausea, yoga or the important postnatal recovery course. You know exactly what would be good for mother and child right now. But these important services add up quickly and health insurance often only covers the bare minimum. Many families forgo your valuable offerings for purely financial reasons.

solution.title: The Solution: The Healio Health Budget
solution.text: Your families secure a budget of up to 3,000 euros. Through smart offsetting with the health insurance bonus, this budget ideally finances itself completely. Your patients have full coverage and effectively pay zero euros for your courses and treatments.

leistungen.title: The €1,100 budget for your families
leistungen.subtitle: So your patients know exactly what to expect, you can show them these benefits directly. The budget ensures that medical extras no longer have to be paid out of pocket.

legal.title: Your Neutrality. 100 Percent Protected.
legal.subtitle: As a midwife, you are committed to the well-being of your patients and strict neutrality. That's exactly how we built our concept for you.
legal.text: The model is legally completely safe. You never act as an advisor and don't recommend specific tariffs. You simply pass on information about how families can smartly cover the services you recommend anyway. The complete and market-independent consultation is handled by us at Healio.
legal.summary: You act as a pure referrer. Your independence is always maintained and you remain in perfect alignment with your strict professional code.
